Notes: ICC Bio-Inspector (ICBI), ICC Shuttleport (4582) at (838.4, 22.9, 757.7). Rebuilt from 7 QuestDialogCapture dumps (ICC_Bio-Inspector_ICBI, 2026-10-20, character Soldmen). Completes HYIY (talk to). The cull chain is 4UM8 > DQOD > SN7R > 5NCC (return); the island-boss chain is PRIF > 070Y > 87A3 > CRTP > ZKO6 > 9BBO (return). While the boss chain runs, and after it, retail showed no greeting text at all, only the reply.

thorn.Text: Brandon Thorn said I should talk to you.

stacklund.Text: Do you know where to find Antonio Stacklund?

sure_help.Text: Sure, I'll help. What do you need?

killed_few.Text: I've killed a few of the creatures.

anything_else.Text: Anything else I can help with?

anything_else_again.Text: Anything else I can help with?

Text: {completequest HYIY}
{emote}The male nanomage looks up from the papers he's reading when you approach and nods. He looks serious but friendly.{/emote}

{emote}He laughs, amused.{/emote}

thorn_good.Text: Good chap, that Thorn. I could use some help here to be honest. Could help clear up your head as well. Or, if you don't have time, maybe I could give some directions?

help_short.Text: I could use some help here to be honest. Could help clear up your head as well. Or, if you don't have time, maybe I could give some directions?

Text: Just run through the tunnel behind me. At the end, you'll come to a ramp leading up to the main compound.
{delay 1} Go past the soldiers and you'll soon find him.
{delay 2}\nIf you decide to stay here, though, let me know. I can always use an extra pair of hands.
Great! I could use the help. Ever since the aliens started attacking Rubi-Ka, we've had regular shuttle crashes, and supplies run short all the time.
{delay 2}I have cataloged the species here, both flora and fauna, and know which ones have beneficial properties.
{delay 2} I'm also in charge of the wildlife cull.

cull.Text: Do you have any idea how fast the animals here on Rubi-Ka breed? If we don't keep the numbers down, they will overrun the island. I need someone to handle a few too many creatures further west on the beach.

Text: {givequest 4UM8}
Great. I'll upload the details to your system. Just head further west and clear out the amount you're asked to. Return to me when you're done, I'll pay you for the job.
{emote}The male nanomage looks up from the papers he's reading when you approach and nods. He looks serious but friendly.{/emote}
\nHello there. I saw you step off the crashed shuttle. I guess I should say 'Welcome to Rubi-Ka', huh?
{emote}He laughs, amused.{/emote}
{completequest 5NCC}
Good job! The eco system here is a fragile thing, and we have to make sure it doesn't go completely wild. Balance is imperative.
{givequest PRIF}

Hm...actually, yes, there is. Each of the animal species here on the beach has a leader. Alpha male or female. I need to note down their location, as the herds and packs move around with them. There's five different ones, but I haven't tracked their movement pattern today and the only one I know the approximate whereabouts of is the snake lead. Should be to the east. \n
{delay 2}I'd like you to find out where they all are, starting with the snake. I'll upload the details to you. Come back when you're done, I'll make sure to compensate you.

You've done more than your share here already, friend. If you want more work, go see Adri Afeli. He's just through the tunnel, keeping an eye on the docks. He always has some job or other going and he pays fair.

adri_where.Text: Adri Afeli could use a hand. He's just through the tunnel, keeping an eye on the docks. He always has some job or other going and he pays fair.

boss_back.Text: Welcome back, friend. How did it go?

Text: {completequest 9BBO}
{givequest AIOJ}
Thank you so much. I'm very grateful for all the help you've given me. Here, take these credits and this range meter I had lying around. I'm sure it'll help you handle the dangers of Rubi-Ka.
